# Test fixtures

Hand-written answers of Apple's web catalog API, in its shape, for step 1e.
`page.html` stands for the web player's page; the tests serve the script
with a token they make.

`live/` holds answers Apple gave on 2026-11-04 in storefront ru: Radiohead's
artist views with their next pages, and the album In Rainbows. They leave
out Apple's editorial notes, which shelf doesn't read. amdl's output
for that album is in `../amdl/testdata/live`.
